title: LLMs are making formal software verification feasible at a much larger scale
script:
Anthropic just scaled formal software verification using its Claude models.
Engineers usually spend months writing tedious mathematical proofs to prove code safety.
Formal verification gives mathematical certainty that software has no critical bugs.
Anthropic proved that AI models can automate writing these complex logic proofs.
The technique successfully verified real open source codebases at a much larger scale.
This removes major bottlenecks in building secure systems across the entire industry.
Would you trust an AI to prove your software never crashes?
